The '''Circle Route''' was a transportation route around and through the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. [[Transport/Legends|Transports]] leaving from the [[Transport Depot]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] traveled the Circle Route every three [[Standard day/Legends|days]], not counting frequent delays and cancellations. The direction of travel alternated, with one transport heading South to West along the route, then the next heading West to South, taking the route in reverse. The route began at [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], traveled around the Jundland Wastes to [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]], then through [[Arnthout Pass]] to [[Motesta]] and [[Arnthout/Legends|Arnthout]], north to [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]], and then again to [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]].<ref name="GG7">''[[Galaxy Guide 7: Mos Eisley]]''</ref>
